meta.name: Tailgate
meta.description: Pickup cargo-bed tailgate that inherits Door locking, unlocking, and door-state queries. Represents the door connection between cargo_bed and exterior; opening and closing affect exchange between the cargo-bed Space and the outside. Instantiate only for vehicle models with a cargo bed.

manual_open.description: Record a local manual action that places the tailgate in the fully open position. This is not a powered opening command. If the tailgate is closed and locked, the action is rejected and all state remains unchanged. Otherwise, including when it is already open, door_state is set to open and closure_feedback is set to false atomically; the lock state is unchanged.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: A closed, locked tailgate cannot be opened. Unlock it before moving it away from the closed position.

manual_set_ajar.description: Record a local manual action that places the tailgate in the ajar or unlatched position. This is not a powered movement command. If the tailgate is closed and locked, the action is rejected and all state remains unchanged. Otherwise, including when it is already ajar, door_state is set to ajar and closure_feedback is set to false atomically; the lock state is unchanged.

errorcodes.PRECONDITION_FAILED: A closed, locked tailgate cannot be set ajar. Unlock it before moving it away from the closed position.
